manifest.source: Complete Rosetta rosetta-groundtruth/1 stream inventory plus type-preserving controlled native session journals.

settings.notes: Global settings (~/.pi/agent/settings.json). Project-local .pi/settings.json lives in the cwd, not under ~/.pi. Keys from 0.84.3 docs: defaultProvider, defaultModel, defaultThinkingLevel, compaction, retry, defaultProjectTrust, enableInstallTelemetry, packages, extensions, skills, prompts, themes, sessionDir, defaultTools, …

models.notes: Custom providers (openai-completions / openai-responses / anthropic-messages / google-generative-ai). Farm writes the mock provider here.

models-store.notes: Cached provider model catalog. Farm harvests `{}` on a first empty-home run.

trust.notes: Saved project-trust decisions. Written by /trust in interactive mode.

auth.notes: Credentials (0600) — MUST-NOT-PARSE; inventory only. Farm strips this file.

agents-md.notes: Global context file concatenated with cwd/parent AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.

system-md.notes: Replaces the default system prompt when present.

append-system-md.notes: Appended to the system prompt without replacing it.

extensions.notes: User TypeScript extensions. Farm runs with --no-extensions.

bin.notes: Managed binaries (fd, rg). Farm strips this tree (vendor bundle).

npm-packages.notes: User-scoped npm pi packages. Farm strips this tree.

git-packages.notes: User-scoped git pi packages. Farm strips this tree.

farm:headless-stdout.notes: Headless stream-json stdout — corroboration surface captured by the farm, not part of the agent data root.

claims.notes: Digest-pinned Rosetta record inventory whose occurrence count is non-zero. It proves occurrence; it proves retained shape only for records classified as fixture or observed rather than writer evidence. Counts and shapes come from the 1.5.0 writer and fixture sources only, not from the cumulative multi-release inventory.
Digest-pinned complete Rosetta stream/shape inventory for pi@1.5.0; writer-only and zero-occurrence records establish a reviewable contract lead, not runtime occurrence.
